verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's docs describe a first-party MCP integration that connects coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) to its databases, using OAuth 2.1 instead of API keys. It exposes tools to list services, run SQL, and read monitoring, which directly delivers this story for a managed database service. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, published endpoint and setup details beyond a single doc summary.
